name: Warlocks Deeds: Uncharted Realms
summary:
Add the following features to your experience of Warlocks Deeds.
Random Worlds: The world is generated procedurally, creating brand new variants of the world ready to be explored and looted. The name you give your world is used as the basis for the seed.
Explorer Mode: Play in explorer mode which allows you to explore and experience the world without worrying about what's around the next corner, All enemy creatures are prevented from spawning.
User Defined: Adjust various sliders allowing you to fine tune the games difficulty.
Hard Core: You get one life to live, If you die then that's the end of that world.
